decisions.platform: Responsive PHP web PWA for desktop, tablet, and mobile
decisions.mvp_scope: Demo authentication and one seeded patient; progress libraries and timeline; longitudinal wounds and daily updates; scoped notes; secure ordered angle-photo gallery
decisions.main_constraints: One self-contained index.php; file-only canonical JSON and media; no dependencies or remote services; explicit opt-in full offline copy; IndexedDB/Cache Storage only for PWA replica and outbox; conflict-aware replay
decisions.supported_browser_scope: Current standards-based desktop, mobile, and tablet browsers, with iPad-responsive layout
decisions.inactive_wound_history_behavior: Deactivation hides the wound from daily entry while retaining history; explicit confirmed delete cascades its records and media
decisions.revision_conflict_policy: Stop replay, preserve pending work, and require reload or explicit review/retry; never silently overwrite

next_action: Render and review the authenticated workspace at an iPad 1024×1366 viewport; browser tooling is unavailable in this environment. After that passes, resume E7.M4 end-to-end closure.
